mapper.select: SELECT * FROM group_link WHERE link_url = #{url} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM group_link WHERE link_url = #{url} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_link (link_url, group_name, label_id, import_batch_id, origin, membership_state, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by) VALUES (#{linkUrl}, #{groupName}, #{labelId}, #{importBatchId}, COALESCE(#{origin}, 1), COALESCE(#{membershipState}, 1), #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, label_id = #{labelId}, import_batch_id = #{batchId}, group_name = COALESCE(#{groupName}, group_name), updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE group_link SET label_id = #{labelId}, import_batch_id = #{batchId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND label_id IS NULL

UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, label_id = NULL, import_batch_id = NULL, group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupName}), ''), group_name), origin = 4, membership_state = 3, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE group_link SET is_historical = 1, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{groupLinkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_historical = 0
UPDATE group_link SET is_post_control = 1, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{groupLinkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_post_control = 0
UPDATE group_link SET is_historical = 1, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{groupLinkId} AND is_historical = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT baseline.tenant_id AS tenantId, COALESCE(by_preview.id, by_url.id) AS groupLinkId, baseline_group.group_jid AS groupJid, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( COALESCE(baseline.baseline_group_subjects, JSON_OBJECT()), CONCAT('$."', baseline_group.group_jid, '"') )) AS groupName, COALESCE(by_preview.deleted_at, by_url.deleted_at) AS deletedAt FROM account_group_baseline baseline INNER JOIN account account ON account.tenant_id = baseline.tenant_id AND account.id = baseline.account_id AND account.deleted_at IS NULL AND account.group_baseline_state = 2 INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( baseline.baseline_group_jids, '$[*]' COLUMNS(group_jid VARCHAR(128) PATH '$') ) baseline_group LEFT JOIN group_link_preview preview ON preview.tenant_id = baseline.tenant_id AND preview.group_jid = baseline_group.group_jid LEFT JOIN group_link by_preview ON by_preview.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND by_preview.id = preview.group_link_id LEFT JOIN group_link by_url ON by_url.tenant_id = baseline.tenant_id AND by_url.link_url = CONCAT('wa://group/', baseline_group.group_jid) WHERE baseline_group.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(baseline_group.group_jid) <> '' AND COALESCE(by_preview.is_historical, by_url.is_historical, 0) = 0 ORDER BY baseline.tenant_id ASC, COALESCE(by_preview.id, by_url.id, 0) ASC, baseline_group.group_jid ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT membership.tenant_id AS tenantId, link.id AS groupLinkId, membership.group_jid AS groupJid, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), ''), preview.wa_subject) AS groupName, link.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM account_group_membership membership INNER JOIN account account ON account.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND account.id = membership.account_id AND account.deleted_at IS NULL AND account.group_baseline_state = 2 INNER JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id INNER JOIN group_link link ON link.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND link.id = membership.group_link_id AND link.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview preview ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id WHERE membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND membership.membership_status = 1 AND link.is_post_control = 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS( COALESCE(baseline.baseline_group_jids, JSON_ARRAY()), JSON_QUOTE(membership.group_jid) ) = 0 ORDER BY membership.tenant_id ASC, link.id ASC, membership.group_jid ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: FROM group_link g LEFT JOIN group_link_import_batch b ON b.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND b.id = g.import_batch_id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND h.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN group_folder f ON f.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND f.id = g.folder_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN country c ON c.iso2 = p.creator_country_iso2 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, group_link_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT phone ORDER BY phone SEPARATOR ', ') AS admin FROM whatsapp_group_member_snapshot WHERE is_admin = 1 AND phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone) <> '' GROUP BY tenant_id, group_link_id ) admins ON admins.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND admins.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT membership.tenant_id, membership.group_link_id, COUNT(DISTINCT membership.account_id) AS availableAdminCount FROM account_group_membership membership INNER JOIN account execution_account ON execution_account.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND execution_account.id = membership.account_id AND execution_account.deleted_at IS NULL AND execution_account.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(execution_account.protocol_account_id) <> '' INNER JOIN account_state execution_state ON execution_state.tenant_id = execution_account.tenant_id AND execution_state.account_id = execution_account.id AND execution_state.login_state = 1 AND execution_state.account_state = 2 WHERE membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND membership.membership_status = 1 AND membership.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY membership.tenant_id, membership.group_link_id ) operable ON operable.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND operable.group_link_id = g.id LEFT JOIN group_metadata_sync_task metadata_task ON metadata_task.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND metadata_task.group_link_id = g.id

sql.if: AND ( g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.wa_subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.link_url LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.invite_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.group_jid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.owner_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR admins.admin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM group_link WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT link.id FROM group_link link LEFT JOIN group_link_preview preview ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id WHERE link.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( preview.group_jid = #{groupJid} OR link.link_url = CONCAT('wa://group/', #{groupJid}) ) ORDER BY link.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT tenantId, groupLinkId, groupJid, accountId, protocolAccountId FROM ( SELECT g.tenant_id AS tenantId, g.id AS groupLinkId, p.group_jid AS groupJid, a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, h.last_check_at AS lastCheckAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY g.tenant_id, g.id ORDER BY r.is_admin DESC, r.id ASC ) AS rowNo FROM group_link g INNER JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.group_link_id = g.id INNER JOIN join_task_result r ON r.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND r.group_jid = p.group_jid AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.account_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.id = r.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND a.protocol_account_id != '' INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} LEFT JOIN group_link_health h ON h.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND h.group_link_id = g.id WHERE g.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND p.group_jid != '' AND (h.is_banned IS NULL OR h.is_banned = 0) ) ranked WHERE rowNo = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(lastCheckAt, 0) ASC, groupLinkId ASC LIMIT #{limit}
